about: A place's own lock is folded as the tree's lock is: a line that carries a signature stands only when a key the tree admits signed it, inside that key's window and inside its coverage of the place, the place's name before the line's scope; a line that carries none is the place's target text until the place signs its lock.
bound's own words are lines of its own lock, read through that fold: never a word spelled by an unsigned file.
A source the fold vouched is read by what vouched it, a digest in the vouching ledger, whatever family named it then; so a family that is renamed leaves what was vouched vouched.
